_comment: The canonical admin URL per Instatic site — the single answer to 'what link do I send?'.
`adminUrl` is the origin a person should work from TODAY; `check-origins.mjs` appends its
www/apex twin automatically, so list only what that would not derive: the client's own
domain when it differs from the Instatic origin, the platform host, staging, an old domain
List a host even when it is currently broken — a host nobody checks is a host nobody fixes,
and the checker's job is to keep saying so until it is clean.
This file is the claim; `node check-origins.mjs --all` is the proof. Re-run it after any
domain change and fix whichever of the two is wrong.
No secrets here. Credentials live in the per-worktree .env and never in this repo.

sites.note: The Instatic origin is encorercm.com and PUBLIC_ORIGIN is set for it (apex + www both pass). The CLIENT-facing domain is drnahlah.com, which 301s to www.drnahlah.com and serves the admin — but is NOT in PUBLIC_ORIGIN, so it is a trap: log in fine, cannot save. Until that is fixed, send encorercm.com/admin.

PUBLIC_ORIGIN is NOT set on the host, so it falls back to RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN. www.masonparkdental.com serves the admin but is rejected as a foreign origin — a trap. Until PUBLIC_ORIGIN is set, the Railway host is the only URL to hand out. Apex masonparkdental.com does not resolve.
